records.mechanism: Literal hypnosis (the 'Ribadier system'): he puts her into a hypnotic sleep by looking into her eyes, then wakes her with a secret cue on his return
records.summary: In this 2008 Paris Première captation of the 1892 Feydeau–Hennequin farce, Eugène Ribadier, Angèle's second husband, uses hypnosis to put his jealous wife to sleep whenever he leaves for an affair, and wakes her when he comes back. The supposedly foolproof system breaks down. Broadcast complete on Paris Première on 13 Dec 2008 at 20:50, with Bruno Solo as Ribadier, Léa Drucker as Angèle, and Jean-Noël Brouté as Aristide Thommereux.
records.fit_note: LITERAL HYPNOSIS by the husband. Identity is exact title + year (2008), not a numeric ID.
records.relationship: Angèle is married to Ribadier (her second husband). She is a widow of her first husband, Robineau.
